kapak.alt: Vestibular function in children with hearing loss

youtube.baslik: Can a child who never complains of dizziness have balance loss? #shorts
youtube.aciklama: Vestibular dysfunction is more common than thought in children with sensorineural hearing loss; according to studies, about 20 to 70 percent of these children have some degree of loss in the vestibular organs. A child with congenital loss does not know the feeling of spinning, so often does not complain of dizziness; families more often notice motor signs such as clumsiness, frequent falls, late sitting or late walking.
